notes.title: Subside patch 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that would allow the player to do the "breaststroke" and "swim turn" while the hands were out of water
Reduced the horizon fog in Cobalt Cove so that the distant mountains and sky are more visible

notes.title: Subside patch 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Improved water mesh with better polygon distribution near the player
Added haptics for when the player hits the water surface
The Diving Weights speed has been increased by 20% and can sink the player closer to the ground
The lemon shark swim speed has been increased
Fixed an issue with the Dogfish sharks not casting a dynamic shadow
Fixed an issue where the beacon marker could still be slightly visible in night maps when toggled off

notes.title: Subside patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
The achievements and the store page have been translated to multiple languages
Many improvements to the water surface in all areas, including better shading and motion
Improvements to the lighting in Flooded Caverns
Added some shadows and bounce lighting to improve the look of the grid ceiling in Koi Haven
Improvements to the Great White Shark physics to help improve the collision with the cage
Improvements to the diving gloves specularity when diving deep underwater
Fixed an issue with the pause menu environment sometime becoming invisible when moving outside the VR playspace
Fixed an issue with the "time spent underwater" stat not incrementing at night
Fixed an issue with the water surface being invisible for a few frames when surfacing using teleportation
Fixed an issue with the bats flying sound playing continuously in some situations
Fixed an issue with the fireflies being visible through the underwater surface

notes.title: Subside patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Improvements to the seaweed shading and animations
Increased the polygon count of the water surface in ocean environments
Improvements to the water colour and reflection in some of the environments
Added a sound effect for the buoys attached to the shark cage
Fixed an issue with the jellyfish being darker than intended in Cobalt Cove night

notes.title: Subside patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
New simpler beacon and cutting torch tutorial
Added some close-up detail textures to the large cliff models
Fixed an issue with some of the hand menu icons not turning blue when selected
Fixed an issue with the lightshafts not dimming while drowning

notes.title: Subside patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Achievements have been added to the game
New content has been added to support some of the achievements
Some small improvements to the water surface
The subtitles are now fully locked to the camera for better scene transitions
Fixed an issue with the crate opening sound effect sometime stacking

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the hologram menu wouldn't close properly when closing the menu with the close button
Fixed an issue where the hands would not match the position of the controllers when grabbing onto large buoyant objects

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
New hologram menu to access holograms from the station
Increased the base swim speed
Increased the base teleport distance
New improved water caustics 
New improved underwater surface normals
Improved the top water surface transparency effect
Fixed an issue where the top water surface transparency effect didn't render correctly on non Oculus headsets
Fixed an issue where the underwater particles would render too close to the eyes
The orange guides on the yellow crate locks now disappear while using the torch
Improved the Great White Shark's skinning weights for smoother body deformation
Some minor performance improvements
Updated the demo to 1.0.9

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.8
notes.notes: Some substantial performance improvements, the water transparency now default to Ultra for new users

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
General performance improvements
Improved the great white shark's open mouth blendshape
Lowered the dither effect that is used to prevent banding on the flashlight effect
Added an animation when hovering the time of day buttons on the level select menu
Fixed an issue with night levels images showing day levels instead when returning to the station
Fixed an issue with foliage billboards being brighter than intended in Cobalt Cove day
Fixed an issue with low quality water surface being brighter than intended

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Whale Improvements


Improved the collision to prevent the player's hands from going through the whales, at the cost of being slightly less accurate
The whales now have animated eyes
The whales polygon count has been increased

General Improvements


Fixed an issue where the player could go through meshes when above the surface
Added haptics when picking up items
Fixed an issue with the transition between the Level select and Tutorial menus
Fixed an issue with the pause menu sometime not fading in properly
Fixed the black floating triangle with no depth in Koi Haven

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with the screen water effects in the Flooded Caverns

Increased the size of the pause menu environment to prevent player from clipping through it when moving outside their playspace

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that could sometime not display the correct completion % for some levels if you used an older save from the demo to play the full game

Increased the Smooth Turn speed (x1.5) to match the Swim Turn speed

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.3
notes.notes: Added button icons on the shop buy confirmation menu while swimming so it's clearer what to press to select yes/no

notes.title: Subside Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the hands wouldn't automatically let go if grabbing the environment and too far away from the motion controllers

Fixed a missing collision for one of the walls in the cave environment

Fixed the collisions for some of the barrels in Cobalt Cove

notes.title: Subside patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The lightnings in Cobalt Cove night are now less bright the deeper you get

The "motion vignette" stereo layer should be properly hidden when the option is not in use, users have reported issues with the motion vignette not being positioned correctly when using OpenXR, just a reminder that Subside only supports OculusVR and SteamVR


Let me know if you have any issues

notes.title: Demo patch 1.0.4
notes.notes: Improved the stereo rendering of the water effects on the diving mask

notes.title: Demo patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Added support for Vive controllers, let me know if you still have any issues
Fixed an issue with the weighted belt when using teleport mode
Fixed an issue that could prevent keys left in chest locks from respawning

notes.title: Demo patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Improved the swim turn mechanic, it's now based on the hand distance from the body and feels much more natural, you can move sideways by keeping your hands close to your body

Thank you all for your feedback

notes.title: Demo patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: Fixed a small issue which didn't properly prevent players to climb walls
